conbody.p: Gatsby is a popular React-based SSG that emphasizes performance and a rich plugin ecosystem. It treats content as data: GraphQL pulls in Markdown, images, CMS content, etc., and generates pages from templates. Gatsby supports Markdown and MDX via plugins. Front matter in Markdown is YAML to supply metadata. Gatsby sites are built with Node.js tools. The default starter site is a React app.
